# FluidEPProgramManager — SUP Emission Program Manager
# Orchestrates SUP emission programs for token distribution via Superfluid GDA pools.
# Each program has a distribution pool; the manager handles creation, funding, stopping, and cancellation.
# Unit updates use signed messages — an off-chain signer authorizes pool units per user.
# Implements IUserDefinedMacro for MacroForwarder integration.
#
# NOTE: Contracts use "FLUID" and "Locker" internally. In all public-facing communication
# these are renamed to "SUP" and "Reserve" respectively. Function/event/error names in this
# file match the on-chain Solidity identifiers (FLUID/Locker).
#
# NOTE: emits/errors mappings are best-effort — verify against source.

meta:
  name: FluidEPProgramManager
  version: v1
  source:
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/FluidEPProgramManager.sol
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/EPProgramManager.sol
  implements: [IEPProgramManager, IUserDefinedMacro]
  inherits: [Initializable, OwnableUpgradeable, EPProgramManager]
  note: >
    Manages SUP emission programs. Owner creates programs and starts/cancels funding.
    Off-chain signers authorize unit updates via EIP-712-style signatures.
    Integrates with MacroForwarder for atomic ERC-20 approval + ACL permission granting.
  deployments:
    base-mainnet: "0x1e32cf099992E9D3b17eDdDFFfeb2D07AED95C6a"

# == Abbreviations ==
# CFA — Constant Flow Agreement
# EP  — Emission Program
# GDA — General Distribution Agreement
# SUP — Superfluid Token (contract name: FLUID)

# == Glossary ==
# FLUID / SUP          — the Superfluid Token; contracts say FLUID, UI says SUP
# Locker / Reserve     — the user's lock/stake contract; contracts say Locker, UI says Reserve
# emission program     — a token distribution campaign; SUP streams from treasury through a GDA pool
# program admin        — the account that can do manual pool updates and change the signer
# stack signer         — off-chain address authorized to sign unit update messages (legacy name from prior points system)
# stack signature      — EIP-712-style signed message from the program's off-chain signer authorizing a unit update
# nonce                — per-user-per-program monotonic counter preventing signature replay
# subsidy rate         — basis-point fraction of the funding flow rate redirected from the tax distribution pool
# funding flow rate    — SUP per second flowing into the program pool from the treasury
# tax distribution pool — shared GDA pool that receives a subsidy flow for each funded program

# == Constants ==

EARLY_PROGRAM_END:
  # Immutable. Time window before program end when stopFunding becomes callable (3 days).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

TAX_DISTRIBUTION_POOL:
  # Immutable. The shared GDA pool that receives subsidy flows from all funded programs.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

subsidyFundingRate:
  # Basis-point rate applied to each program's funding flow to compute the subsidy flow.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint96

# == Program Lifecycle ==

createProgram:
  # Creates a new emission program with a dedicated GDA distribution pool.
  # The pool is created with custom ERC-20 metadata (name/symbol).
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256           # must be > 0
    - programAdmin: address
    - signer: address              # off-chain signer for unit update authorization
    - token: address               # ISuperToken used for distribution
    - poolName: string
    - poolSymbol: string
  outputs:
    - distributionPool: address
  emits: [ProgramCreated]
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER
    - PROGRAM_ALREADY_CREATED

startFunding:
  # Starts a CFA flow from the treasury into the program's distribution pool.
  # Also starts a subsidy GDA flow from the tax distribution pool.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Requires the program admin to have pre-approved SUP ERC-20 allowance and Superfluid ACL flow rate permissions. Use calculateAllowances to compute the exact amounts, or use MacroForwarder with paramsGivePermission."
    - "Gotcha: The pool must have at least one member with units > 0 before funding."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - totalAmount: uint256         # total SUP to distribute over the program duration
    - programDuration: uint32      # duration in seconds
  emits: [ProgramFunded]
  errors:
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - POOL_HAS_NO_UNITS

stopFunding:
  # Stops funding by deleting the treasury flow and subsidy flow.
  # Compensates for unused funds by transferring remaining amounts back.
  # Anyone can call this — no access restriction.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Can only be called within the EARLY_PROGRAM_END window before the end date."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  emits: [ProgramStopped]
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER
    - TOO_EARLY_TO_END_PROGRAM

cancelProgram:
  # Cancels a program, returning the deposit. Differs from stopFunding —
  # cancel returns the full deposit; stop compensates for unused funds.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  emits: [ProgramCancelled]
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER

# == Unit Updates ==
# Signed-message-based pool unit updates. An off-chain signer authorizes how many
# pool units each user receives based on their accumulated points.

updateUnits:
  # Updates the caller's units in a program's distribution pool.
  # Delegates to updateUserUnits with msg.sender as the user.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Requires a valid signature from the program's off-chain signer."
    - "Gotcha: The nonce must be strictly greater than the last used nonce (use getNextValidNonce)."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - newUnits: uint256
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [UserUnitsUpdated]
  errors:
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - INVALID_SIGNATURE
    - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

updateUserUnits:
  # Updates a specific user's units in a program's distribution pool.
  # The actual pool member is the user's Locker (Reserve) contract, looked up via fluidLockerFactory.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - user: address
    - programId: uint256
    - newUnits: uint256
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [UserUnitsUpdated]
  errors:
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - INVALID_PARAMETER
    - INVALID_SIGNATURE
    - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

batchUpdateUnits:
  # Updates the caller's units across multiple programs in one transaction.
  # Delegates to batchUpdateUserUnits with msg.sender as the user.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: programIds and newUnits arrays must have equal length."
    - "Gotcha: All programs in the batch must share the same signer."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - programIds: uint256[]
    - newUnits: uint256[]
    - nonce: uint256               # single nonce validated per-program
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [UserUnitsUpdated]
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER
    - INVALID_SIGNATURE
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

batchUpdateUserUnits:
  # Updates a specific user's units across multiple programs in one transaction.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: All programs in the batch must share the same signer."
    - "Gotcha: programIds and newUnits arrays must have equal length and be non-empty."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - user: address
    - programIds: uint256[]
    - newUnits: uint256[]
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [UserUnitsUpdated]
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER
    - INVALID_SIGNATURE
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

# == Manual Updates ==
# Admin fallback for updating pool units without signatures.

"manualPoolUpdate(uint256,uint256,address)":
  # Updates a single user's pool units directly (no signature needed).
  # The actual pool member is the user's Locker (Reserve), looked up via fluidLockerFactory.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: program-admin
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - stackPoints: uint256
    - user: address
  errors:
    - NOT_PROGRAM_ADMIN
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

"manualPoolUpdate(uint256,uint256[],address[])":
  # Batch version — updates pool units for multiple users directly.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: stackPoints and users arrays must have equal length and be non-empty."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: program-admin
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - stackPoints: uint256[]
    - users: address[]
  errors:
    - NOT_PROGRAM_ADMIN
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - INVALID_PARAMETER
    - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

# == Query ==

programs:
  # Mapping getter — returns core program data.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  outputs:
    - programAdmin: address
    - stackSigner: address
    - token: address               # ISuperToken
    - distributionPool: address    # ISuperfluidPool

getProgramDetails:
  # Returns funding and timing details for a program.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  outputs:
    - details:
        type: tuple
        components:
          - fundingFlowRate: int96
          - subsidyFlowRate: int96
          - fundingStartDate: uint32
          - duration: uint32

getProgramPool:
  # Returns the GDA distribution pool address for a program.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  outputs:
    - programPool: address

getNextValidNonce:
  # Returns the next valid nonce for a user in a program.
  # Nonces are per-user-per-program and must be strictly monotonically increasing.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - user: address
  outputs:
    - validNonce: uint256

calculateAllowances:
  # Computes the exact ERC-20 deposit allowance and CFA flow rate allowance
  # the program admin needs to grant before calling startFunding.
  # Deposit covers the CFA buffer + early-end compensation.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - plannedFundingAmount: uint256
    - plannedProgramDuration: uint32
  outputs:
    - depositAllowance: uint256
    - flowRateAllowance: int96

# == MacroForwarder Integration ==
# IUserDefinedMacro functions for atomic ERC-20 approval + ACL permission granting
# via MacroForwarder.runMacro().

buildBatchOperations:
  # Builds batch operations for MacroForwarder: ERC-20 approve + CFA flow rate allowance.
  # Called by MacroForwarder.runMacro() to construct the batch.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - host: address                # ISuperfluid host
    - params: bytes                # encoded (programId, depositAllowance, flowRateAllowance, token)
    - address                      # unused (msgSender placeholder)
  outputs:
    - operations:
        type: tuple[]
        components:
          - operationType: uint32
          - target: address
          - data: bytes

paramsGivePermission:
  # Encodes parameters for MacroForwarder.runMacro().
  # Computes allowances via calculateAllowances and packs them with the program token.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - amount: uint256              # planned funding amount
    - duration: uint32             # planned program duration
  outputs:
    - bytes

postCheck:
  # IUserDefinedMacro post-execution hook. No-op in this contract.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - host: address
    - params: bytes
    - msgSender: address

# == Admin ==

initialize:
  # UUPS initializer. Sets owner and treasury address.
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - owner: address
    - treasury: address

setLockerFactory:
  # Sets the Locker (Reserve) factory contract address.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - lockerFactoryAddress: address
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER

setTreasury:
  # Sets the treasury address that funds emission programs.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - treasuryAddress: address
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER

setSubsidyRate:
  # Sets the basis-point rate for subsidy flow computation.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - subsidyRate: uint96          # must be <= basis point denominator
  errors:
    - INVALID_PARAMETER

updateProgramSigner:
  # Changes the off-chain signer for a program.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: program-admin
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - newSigner: address
  emits: [ProgramSignerUpdated]
  errors:
    - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
    - NOT_PROGRAM_ADMIN
    - INVALID_PARAMETER

emergencyWithdraw:
  # Transfers the entire balance of a Super Token from this contract to the treasury.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - token: address

transferOwnership:
  # Transfers contract ownership (inherited from OwnableUpgradeable).
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - newOwner: address
  emits: [OwnershipTransferred]
  errors:
    - OwnableInvalidOwner

renounceOwnership:
  # Renounces contract ownership (inherited from OwnableUpgradeable).
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  emits: [OwnershipTransferred]

# == State Queries ==

fluidLockerFactory:
  # Returns the Locker (Reserve) factory contract address.
  # NOTE: "Locker" = "Reserve" in public-facing naming.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

fluidTreasury:
  # Returns the treasury address.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

owner:
  # Returns the current contract owner (inherited from OwnableUpgradeable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

# == Upgrade ==

upgradeTo:
  # UUPS upgrade — replaces the implementation and optionally calls an initializer.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: owner
  inputs:
    - newImplementation: address
    - data: bytes                  # calldata for optional re-initialization
  emits: [Upgraded]
  errors:
    - ERC1967InvalidImplementation

# == Events ==

events:

  ProgramCreated:
    # Emitted when a new emission program is created.
    data:
      - programId: uint256
      - programAdmin: address
      - signer: address
      - token: address
      - distributionPool: address

  ProgramFunded:
    # Emitted when funding starts for a program.
    indexed:
      - programId: uint256
      - fundingAmount: uint256
      - subsidyAmount: uint256
    data:
      - earlyEndDate: uint256
      - endDate: uint256

  ProgramStopped:
    # Emitted when funding is stopped (within the EARLY_PROGRAM_END window).
    indexed:
      - programId: uint256
      - fundingCompensationAmount: uint256
      - subsidyCompensationAmount: uint256

  ProgramCancelled:
    # Emitted when a program is cancelled and deposit is returned.
    indexed:
      - programId: uint256
      - returnedDeposit: uint256

  ProgramSignerUpdated:
    # Emitted when a program's off-chain signer is changed.
    data:
      - programId: uint256
      - newSigner: address

  UserUnitsUpdated:
    # Emitted for each user whose pool units are updated (via signed or batch updates).
    data:
      - user: address
      - programId: uint256
      - newUnits: uint256

  OwnershipTransferred:
    indexed:
      - previousOwner: address
      - newOwner: address

  Upgraded:
    indexed:
      - implementation: address

  Initialized:
    data:
      - version: uint64

# == Errors ==

errors:

  # -- Program Lifecycle --
  - PROGRAM_ALREADY_CREATED
  - PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
  - POOL_HAS_NO_UNITS
  - TOO_EARLY_TO_END_PROGRAM

  # -- Validation --
  - CFA_INVALID_FLOW_RATE
  - INVALID_PARAMETER
  - NOT_PROGRAM_ADMIN

  # -- Signature --
  - INVALID_SIGNATURE:
      inputs:
        - reason: string

  # -- Locker --
  - LOCKER_NOT_FOUND

  # -- Ownable (inherited) --
  - OwnableInvalidOwner:
      inputs:
        - owner: address
  - OwnableUnauthorizedAccount:
      inputs:
        - account: address

  # -- Proxy / Upgrade (inherited) --
  - AddressEmptyCode:
      inputs:
        - target: address
  - ERC1967InvalidImplementation:
      inputs:
        - implementation: address
  - ERC1967NonPayable
  - FailedInnerCall
  - InvalidInitialization
  - NotInitializing

  # -- SafeCast (inherited) --
  - SafeCastOverflowedIntDowncast:
      inputs:
        - bits: uint8
        - value: int256

# FluidLocker — per-user SUP reserve contract (lock, stake, LP, unlock)
# Core user-facing contract in the SUP ecosystem. Each user has one FluidLocker
# deployed by FluidLockerFactory as a beacon proxy. Manages SUP in three states:
# available (locked but liquid), staked (earning rewards), and in Uniswap V3 LP positions.
#
# NOTE: The contracts use "FLUID" and "Locker" internally. In all public-facing
# communication these have been renamed to "SUP" and "Reserve" respectively.
# Function/event/error names here match the on-chain Solidity identifiers.
#
# NOTE: emits/errors mappings are best-effort — verify against source.

meta:
  name: FluidLocker
  version: v1
  source:
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/FluidLocker.sol
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IFluidLocker.sol
  implements: [IFluidLocker]
  # No fixed deployments — FluidLocker instances are created per-user by
  # FluidLockerFactory as beacon proxies.

# == Abbreviations ==
# BP  — Basis Points (1 BP = 0.01%, 10000 BP = 100%)
# CFA — Constant Flow Agreement
# EP  — Emission Program
# GDA — General Distribution Agreement
# LP  — Liquidity Provider (Uniswap V3)
# SUP — Superfluid Token (contract name: FLUID)
# TTE — Token Transfer Engine (unlock mechanism)

# == Glossary ==
# FLUID / SUP              — the Superfluid Token; contracts say FLUID, UI says SUP
# Locker / Reserve         — this contract; user's lock/stake container; contracts say Locker, UI says Reserve
# Fontaine                 — single-use unlock stream contract; deployed per-unlock as beacon proxy
# available balance        — SUP locked in the locker but not staked or in LP positions; can be unlocked
# staked balance           — SUP committed to staking; earns reward distribution units
# liquidity balance        — SUP committed to Uniswap V3 ETH/SUP LP positions
# staking cooldown         — 30-day period after staking before unstaking is allowed (stakingUnlocksAt)
# LP cooldown              — 7-day period after providing liquidity before withdrawal is allowed
# tax-free withdraw delay  — 180-day waiting period after LP position creation before tax-free exit
# unlock period            — duration of a Fontaine unlock stream; longer = lower fee (7–365 days)
# instant unlock           — unlockPeriod of 0; immediate transfer with 80% penalty
# unlocking fee            — 0.0001 ETH sent to DAO_TREASURY on every unlock
# pump ratio               — BP portion of SUP swapped to ETH when providing liquidity (100 BP = 1%)
# slippage tolerance       — max acceptable slippage for Uniswap swaps (500 BP = 5%)
# emission program         — distribution campaign; SUP streams from program pools
# stack signature          — off-chain signed message authorizing emission program claims (legacy parameter name)

# == Constants ==

FLUID:
  # The SUP SuperToken address (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

EP_PROGRAM_MANAGER:
  # Emission program manager contract (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

STAKING_REWARD_CONTROLLER:
  # Controls staking reward distribution (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

FONTAINE_BEACON:
  # UpgradeableBeacon for Fontaine unlock stream proxies (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

DAO_TREASURY:
  # Receives unlocking fees (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

ETH_SUP_POOL:
  # Uniswap V3 ETH/SUP pool (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

NONFUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER:
  # Uniswap V3 NonfungiblePositionManager (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

SWAP_ROUTER:
  # Uniswap V3 SwapRouter (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

STAKER_DISTRIBUTION_POOL:
  # GDA pool for staking reward distributions (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

LP_DISTRIBUTION_POOL:
  # GDA pool for LP reward distributions (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

MIN_UNLOCK_AMOUNT:
  # 10 SUP — minimum amount that can be unlocked.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

UNLOCKING_FEE:
  # 0.0001 ETH — flat fee sent to DAO_TREASURY on every unlock.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

TAX_FREE_WITHDRAW_DELAY:
  # 180 days — waiting period after LP position creation before tax-free exit.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

LP_OPERATION_DEADLINE:
  # 1 minute — deadline offset for Uniswap LP operations.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

BP_PUMP_RATIO:
  # 100 BP (1%) — portion of SUP swapped to ETH when providing liquidity.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

BP_SLIPPAGE_TOLERANCE:
  # 500 BP (5%) — max acceptable slippage for Uniswap swaps.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

UNLOCK_AVAILABLE:
  # Feature flag; if false, unlock/provideLiquidity/withdrawLiquidity/collectFees revert.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - bool

# == Locking ==

lock:
  # Transfer SUP from msg.sender into this locker, adding to available balance.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Requires prior ERC-20 approval on the SUP token. Calls FLUID.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount)."
    - "Gotcha: Anyone can lock SUP into this locker — no onlyLockerOwner check."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - amount: uint256
  emits: [FluidLocked]

# == Staking ==

stake:
  # Move SUP from available to staked balance. Imposes a 30-day cooldown
  # before unstaking (resets on each stake call).
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Stakes the entire available balance if amount > available."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - amountToStake: uint256
  emits: [FluidStaked]
  errors: [INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE]

unstake:
  # Move SUP from staked back to available balance.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Reverts if the 30-day staking cooldown has not elapsed."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - amountToUnstake: uint256
  emits: [FluidUnstaked]
  errors: [STAKING_COOLDOWN_NOT_ELAPSED, INSUFFICIENT_STAKED_BALANCE]

# == Emission Program Claims ==
# Claims connect the locker to emission programs and update units via signed messages.
# Requires a valid signature from the emission program's off-chain signer.
# The nonce must match getNextValidNonce on FluidEPProgramManager.
# The signer address is configured per-program in FluidEPProgramManager (createProgram / updateProgramSigner).

"claim(uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes)":
  # Claim from a single emission program; updates locker's units in the program pool.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: The stackSignature is obtained from the Superfluid points API (GET /points/signed-balance)."
    - "Gotcha: connect() must be called for the program before claiming."
    - "Gotcha: No onlyLockerOwner — anyone can submit a valid claim on behalf of the locker."
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - totalProgramUnits: uint256
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [FluidStreamClaimed]

"claim(uint256[],uint256[],uint256,bytes)":
  # Batch claim from multiple emission programs in one transaction.
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - "programIds: uint256[]"
    - "totalProgramUnits: uint256[]"
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [FluidStreamsClaimed]

"claimAndStake(uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes)":
  # Claim from a single program, then stake ALL available balance.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Stakes the entire available balance, not just the claimed amount."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
    - totalProgramUnits: uint256
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [FluidStreamClaimed, FluidStaked]
  errors: [INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE]

"claimAndStake(uint256[],uint256[],uint256,bytes)":
  # Batch claim from multiple programs, then stake ALL available balance.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Stakes the entire available balance, not just the claimed amount."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - "programIds: uint256[]"
    - "totalProgramUnits: uint256[]"
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [FluidStreamsClaimed, FluidStaked]
  errors: [INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE]

connect:
  # Connect this locker to an emission program's GDA pool.
  # Must be called before claim() for that program.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256

"disconnect(uint256)":
  # Disconnect this locker from a single emission program's GDA pool.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256

"disconnect(uint256[])":
  # Batch disconnect from multiple emission programs.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - "programIds: uint256[]"

disconnectAndClaim:
  # Disconnect from some programs and claim from others in one transaction.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Combines disconnect + batch claim atomically."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - "programIdsToDisconnect: uint256[]"
    - "programIdsToClaim: uint256[]"
    - "totalProgramUnits: uint256[]"
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [FluidStreamsClaimed]

disconnectAndClaimAndStake:
  # Disconnect from some programs, claim from others, then stake ALL available balance.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Stakes the entire available balance, not just the claimed amount."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - "programIdsToDisconnect: uint256[]"
    - "programIdsToClaim: uint256[]"
    - "totalProgramUnits: uint256[]"
    - nonce: uint256
    - stackSignature: bytes
  emits: [FluidStreamsClaimed, FluidStaked]
  errors: [INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE]

# == Unlocking ==
# Unlocking creates a Fontaine that streams SUP over the unlock period.
# unlockPeriod=0 is instant unlock with 80% penalty. Otherwise 7–365 days.
# Longer unlock periods result in lower effective tax on the unlocked amount.

unlock:
  # Unlock SUP from available balance via a time-delayed Fontaine stream.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Payable — msg.value must equal UNLOCKING_FEE (0.0001 ETH), sent to DAO_TREASURY."
    - "Gotcha: unlockPeriod=0 triggers instant unlock with 80% penalty; remaining 20% transferred immediately, 80% redistributed to stakers/LPs."
    - "Gotcha: unlockPeriod between 7 and 365 days deploys a Fontaine beacon proxy that streams SUP to the recipient over the unlock period with a proportional tax."
    - "Gotcha: Requires UNLOCK_AVAILABLE feature flag to be true; otherwise reverts TTE_NOT_ACTIVATED."
  mutability: payable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - unlockAmount: uint256
    - unlockPeriod: uint128      # 0 = instant, or 7–365 days in seconds
    - recipient: address
  emits: [FluidUnlocked]
  errors:
    - INVALID_UNLOCKING_FEE
    - TTE_NOT_ACTIVATED
    - INVALID_UNLOCK_PERIOD
    - INSUFFICIENT_UNLOCK_AMOUNT
    - INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE
    - STAKER_DISTRIBUTION_POOL_HAS_NO_UNITS
    - LP_DISTRIBUTION_POOL_HAS_NO_UNITS

# == Liquidity Provision ==
# Uniswap V3 ETH/SUP LP positions managed through the locker.
# Requires UNLOCK_AVAILABLE feature flag.

provideLiquidity:
  # Take SUP from available balance, swap a portion to ETH via Uniswap, and create
  # a V3 LP position. Returns the Uniswap NFT position token ID.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Payable — accepts ETH via msg.value for the LP position."
    - "Gotcha: Uses BP_PUMP_RATIO (1%) of SUP to swap for ETH."
    - "Gotcha: Imposes a 7-day LP cooldown before withdrawal is allowed."
    - "Gotcha: Records a tax-free exit timestamp at creation + TAX_FREE_WITHDRAW_DELAY (180 days)."
  mutability: payable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - supAmount: uint256
  outputs:
    - positionTokenId: uint256
  emits: [LiquidityPositionCreated]
  errors:
    - TTE_NOT_ACTIVATED
    - INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE

withdrawLiquidity:
  # Remove liquidity from a Uniswap V3 position and return SUP to available balance.
  # Burns the NFT if all liquidity is removed.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Subject to 7-day LP cooldown (LP_COOLDOWN_NOT_ELAPSED)."
    - "Gotcha: Subject to tax if withdrawn before tax-free exit timestamp (180 days after creation)."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - tokenId: uint256
    - liquidityToRemove: uint128
    - amount0ToRemove: uint256
    - amount1ToRemove: uint256
  emits: [LiquidityPositionBurned]
  errors:
    - TTE_NOT_ACTIVATED
    - LOCKER_HAS_NO_POSITION
    - LP_COOLDOWN_NOT_ELAPSED

collectFees:
  # Collect accumulated trading fees from a Uniswap V3 LP position.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner
  inputs:
    - tokenId: uint256
  outputs:
    - collectedEthx: uint256
    - collectedSup: uint256
  errors:
    - TTE_NOT_ACTIVATED
    - LOCKER_HAS_NO_POSITION

withdrawDustETH:
  # Withdraw any residual ETH left in the locker from LP operations.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: locker-owner

# == Balance Queries ==

getAvailableBalance:
  # SUP locked but not staked or in LP — can be unlocked or staked.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - aBalance: uint256

getStakedBalance:
  # SUP committed to staking, earning reward distribution units.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - sBalance: uint256

getLiquidityBalance:
  # SUP committed to Uniswap V3 ETH/SUP LP positions.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - lBalance: uint256

lockerOwner:
  # The wallet address that owns this locker.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

stakingUnlocksAt:
  # Timestamp when the staking cooldown expires and unstaking is allowed.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint80

activePositionCount:
  # Number of active Uniswap V3 LP positions held by this locker.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

# == Program Queries ==

"getUnitsPerProgram(uint256)":
  # Units this locker holds in a single emission program's GDA pool.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  outputs:
    - units: uint128

"getUnitsPerProgram(uint256[])":
  # Batch query: units this locker holds across multiple emission programs.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - "programIds: uint256[]"
  outputs:
    - "units: uint128[]"

"getFlowRatePerProgram(uint256)":
  # Flow rate this locker receives from a single emission program.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - programId: uint256
  outputs:
    - flowRate: int96

"getFlowRatePerProgram(uint256[])":
  # Batch query: flow rates this locker receives from multiple emission programs.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - "programIds: uint256[]"
  outputs:
    - "flowRates: int96[]"

# == Fontaine & Position Queries ==

fontaines:
  # Look up the Fontaine contract address for a given unlock ID.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - unlockId: uint256
  outputs:
    - fontaine: address

fontaineCount:
  # Total number of Fontaine unlock streams created by this locker.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint16

getFontaineBeaconImplementation:
  # Current implementation address behind the Fontaine beacon proxy.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - fontaineBeaconImpl: address

lpCooldownTimestamps:
  # Timestamp when the LP cooldown expires for a given position.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - positionTokenId: uint256
  outputs:
    - lpCooldownTimestamp: uint256

taxFreeExitTimestamps:
  # Timestamp after which an LP position can be withdrawn tax-free.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - positionTokenId: uint256
  outputs:
    - taxFreeWithdrawTimestamp: uint256

getPositionLiquidity:
  # Uniswap V3 liquidity amount for a given position token ID.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - tokenId: uint256
  outputs:
    - liquidity: uint128

# == Lifecycle ==

initialize:
  # Beacon proxy initializer. Called once by FluidLockerFactory during creation.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Can only be called once (initializer modifier)."
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - owner: address
  emits: [Initialized]

# == Events ==

events:

  FluidLocked:
    # SUP deposited into the locker.
    indexed:
      - amount: uint256

  FluidStaked:
    # SUP moved from available to staked.
    indexed:
      - newTotalStakedBalance: uint256
      - addedAmount: uint256

  FluidUnstaked:
    # SUP moved from staked back to available.
    indexed:
      - newTotalStakedBalance: uint256
      - removedAmount: uint256

  FluidStreamClaimed:
    # Single emission program claim executed.
    indexed:
      - programId: uint256
      - totalProgramUnits: uint256

  FluidStreamsClaimed:
    # Batch emission program claims executed.
    indexed:
      - "programId: uint256[]"
      - "totalProgramUnits: uint256[]"

  FluidUnlocked:
    # SUP unlock initiated (instant or Fontaine stream).
    indexed:
      - unlockPeriod: uint128
      - availableBalance: uint256
      - fontaine: address
    data:
      - recipient: address

  LiquidityPositionCreated:
    # Uniswap V3 LP position minted through the locker.
    indexed:
      - tokenId: uint256

  LiquidityPositionBurned:
    # Uniswap V3 LP position burned (all liquidity removed).
    indexed:
      - tokenId: uint256

  Initialized:
    # OpenZeppelin initializer event (emitted once on proxy setup).
    data:
      - version: uint64

# == Errors ==

errors:

  # -- Access --
  - NOT_LOCKER_OWNER
  - FORBIDDEN

  # -- Staking --
  - STAKING_COOLDOWN_NOT_ELAPSED
  - INSUFFICIENT_STAKED_BALANCE
  - STAKER_DISTRIBUTION_POOL_HAS_NO_UNITS

  # -- Unlocking --
  - TTE_NOT_ACTIVATED
  - INVALID_UNLOCKING_FEE
  - INVALID_UNLOCK_PERIOD
  - INSUFFICIENT_UNLOCK_AMOUNT
  - NO_FLUID_TO_UNLOCK

# FluidLockerFactory — beacon proxy factory that deploys one Reserve per user
# Creates deterministic FluidLocker (Reserve) instances via BeaconProxy so
# addresses can be computed before deployment. The governor can pause creation
# and upgrade the beacon implementation.
#
# NOTE: Contracts use "FLUID" and "Locker" internally. Public-facing names are
# "SUP" and "Reserve" respectively. Function/event/error names here match the
# on-chain Solidity identifiers.
#
# NOTE: emits/errors mappings are best-effort — verify against source.

meta:
  name: FluidLockerFactory
  version: v1
  source:
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/FluidLockerFactory.sol
  deployments:
    mainnet:
      base-mainnet: "0xA6694cAB43713287F7735dADc940b555db9d39D9"

# == Abbreviations ==
# ERC1967 — proxy storage standard used by UpgradeableBeacon

# == Glossary ==
# FLUID / SUP        — the Superfluid governance token; contracts say FLUID, UI says SUP
# Locker / Reserve   — the user's lock/stake contract; contracts say Locker, UI says Reserve
# beacon proxy       — upgradable proxy pointing to a shared implementation via UpgradeableBeacon
# governor           — privileged account that can pause creation, upgrade, and set a new governor

# == Reserve Creation ==

"createLockerContract(address)":
  # Deploy a new Reserve (Locker) for a specific user.
  # Reverts if the factory is paused.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Deterministic — the same user always maps to the same locker address."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - user: address
  outputs:
    - lockerInstance: address
  emits:
    - LockerCreated
  errors:
    - LOCKER_CREATION_PAUSED

"createLockerContract()":
  # Deploy a new Reserve (Locker) for msg.sender. Convenience overload.
  # Reverts if the factory is paused.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Deterministic — the same user always maps to the same locker address."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  outputs:
    - lockerInstance: address
  emits:
    - LockerCreated
  errors:
    - LOCKER_CREATION_PAUSED

# == Query ==

getLockerAddress:
  # Compute the deterministic address for a user's Reserve.
  # Returns the address regardless of whether the locker has been deployed.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - user: address
  outputs:
    - lockerAddress: address

getUserLocker:
  # Check whether a user's Reserve exists and return its address.
  # isCreated is false if the locker has not been deployed yet.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - user: address
  outputs:
    - isCreated: bool
    - lockerAddress: address

getLockerBeaconImplementation:
  # Current implementation address behind the UpgradeableBeacon.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - lockerBeaconImpl: address

# == Constants ==

IS_PAUSED:
  # Whether Reserve creation is paused (immutable, set at construction).
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: If true, both createLockerContract overloads revert."
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - bool

LOCKER_BEACON:
  # The UpgradeableBeacon contract that all Reserve proxies point to (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

STAKING_REWARD_CONTROLLER:
  # The staking reward controller contract (immutable).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

# == Governance ==

governor:
  # Current governor address.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

setGovernor:
  # Transfer the governor role to a new address.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: governor
  inputs:
    - newGovernor: address
  emits:
    - GovernorUpdated
  errors:
    - NOT_GOVERNOR

initialize:
  # Proxy initializer — sets the initial governor. Called once after deployment.
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - _governor: address
  errors:
    - InvalidInitialization

# == Upgrade ==

upgradeTo:
  # Upgrade the beacon implementation to a new FluidLocker logic contract.
  # Optional data is forwarded as a delegatecall to the new implementation.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: governor
  inputs:
    - newImplementation: address
    - data: bytes
  emits:
    - Upgraded
  errors:
    - NOT_GOVERNOR
    - ERC1967InvalidImplementation
    - AddressEmptyCode
    - FailedInnerCall

# == Events ==

events:

  LockerCreated:
    # Emitted when a new Reserve is deployed for a user.
    data:
      - lockerOwner: address
      - lockerAddress: address

  GovernorUpdated:
    # Emitted when the governor is changed via setGovernor.
    data:
      - newGovernor: address

  Upgraded:
    # Emitted when the beacon implementation is upgraded (ERC1967).
    indexed:
      - implementation: address

  Initialized:
    # OpenZeppelin Initializable — emitted when initialize is called.
    data:
      - version: uint64

# == Errors ==

errors:

  # -- Access Control --
  - NOT_GOVERNOR                   # caller is not the governor

  # -- Creation --
  - LOCKER_CREATION_PAUSED         # factory IS_PAUSED is true

  # -- Initialization --
  - InvalidInitialization          # already initialized or not in initializer context
  - NotInitializing                # modifier onlyInitializing check failed

  # -- Proxy / ERC1967 --
  - AddressEmptyCode:
      inputs:
        - target: address
  - ERC1967InvalidImplementation:
      inputs:
        - implementation: address
  - ERC1967NonPayable              # implementation received ETH unexpectedly
  - FailedInnerCall                # delegatecall to new implementation reverted

# Fontaine — single-use unlock stream contract
# Streams SUP from a Reserve (Locker) to a recipient over a fixed period at a constant flow rate.
# Created as a beacon proxy per-unlock by FluidLocker; destroyed after the unlock period ends.
#
# NOTE: The contracts use "FLUID" and "Locker" internally. In all public-facing communication
# these have been renamed to "SUP" and "Reserve" respectively. Function, event, and error
# names in this file match the on-chain Solidity identifiers.
# NOTE: emits/errors mappings are traced from source code — verify against implementation.

meta:
  name: Fontaine
  version: v1
  source:
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/Fontaine.sol
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superfluid-org/sup-token/refs/heads/dev/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IFontaine.sol
  implements: [IFontaine]
  inherits: [Initializable]
  # No fixed deployments — Fontaine instances are created per-unlock by FluidLocker as beacon proxies.
  # Logic: 0x45FF512Cd98963C8fB5302E53227BC8b21448B3c (Base mainnet)
  # Beacon: 0xA26FbA47Da24F7DF11b3E4CF60Dcf7D1691Ae47d (Base mainnet)

# == Abbreviations ==
# CFA — Constant Flow Agreement
# SUP — Superfluid Token (contract name: FLUID)

# == Glossary ==
# FLUID / SUP        — the Superfluid Token; contracts say FLUID, UI says SUP
# Locker / Reserve   — the user's lock/stake contract; contracts say Locker, UI says Reserve
# Fontaine           — this contract; a single-use unlock stream
# unlockPeriod       — duration of the unlock stream in seconds
# unlockFlowRate     — SUP per second flowing from Fontaine to recipient

# == Constants ==

FLUID:
  # Immutable reference to the SUP SuperToken (set in constructor, shared across all proxies).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

EARLY_END:
  # Grace period before endDate during which terminateUnlock is blocked (1 day = 86400 seconds).
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint256

# == State ==

recipient:
  # Address receiving the SUP unlock stream.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

endDate:
  # Timestamp when the unlock stream is scheduled to finish.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint128

unlockFlowRate:
  # SUP per second flowing from this Fontaine to the recipient.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint96

# == Lifecycle ==

initialize:
  # Beacon proxy initializer. Called once by FluidLocker when creating an unlock.
  # Sets the recipient, calculates the end date, and opens a CFA stream of SUP.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Can only be called once (OpenZeppelin initializer modifier)."
    - "Gotcha: Reverts if unlockRecipient is a Super App — streaming to Super Apps is forbidden."
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - unlockRecipient: address
    - targetUnlockFlowRate: int96  # SUP wei per second
    - unlockPeriod: uint128        # duration in seconds
  emits:
    - Initialized
  errors:
    - CANNOT_UNLOCK_TO_SUPERAPP
    - CFA_INVALID_FLOW_RATE
    - InvalidInitialization

# == Unlock Management ==

terminateUnlock:
  # Stop the unlock stream and transfer any remaining SUP balance to the recipient.
  # Any address can terminate once the timing condition is met.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Can only be called after (endDate - EARLY_END) has passed — reverts with TOO_EARLY_TO_TERMINATE_UNLOCK if block.timestamp < endDate - EARLY_END."
    - "Gotcha: Callable by anyone — the contract has no msg.sender restriction on this function."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  errors:
    - TOO_EARLY_TO_TERMINATE_UNLOCK
    - NO_ACTIVE_UNLOCK

# == Events ==

events:
  Initialized:
    # Emitted on proxy initialization (inherited from OpenZeppelin Initializable).
    data:
      - version: uint64

# == Errors ==

errors:
  # Unlock validation
  - CANNOT_UNLOCK_TO_SUPERAPP       # recipient is a Super App — streaming forbidden
  - CFA_INVALID_FLOW_RATE           # flow rate is invalid (zero or negative)
  - NO_ACTIVE_UNLOCK                # no active unlock stream to terminate
  - TOO_EARLY_TO_TERMINATE_UNLOCK   # block.timestamp < endDate - EARLY_END
  # Access control
  - NOT_CONNECTED_LOCKER            # caller is not the FluidLocker (Reserve) that initialized this Fontaine
  # Initializable (inherited from OpenZeppelin)
  - InvalidInitialization
  - NotInitializing

# == Glossary ==
# pool                  — a SuperfluidPool contract distributing tokens to members
# pool admin            — the address that manages member units and pool config
# member                — an address holding units in a pool
# connected             — member receives distributions in real-time
# disconnected          — member must claim distributions manually
# adjustment flow       — rounding remainder flow directed to the pool admin

# == Pool Creation ==

createPool:
  # Create a new SuperfluidPool. Called directly (not routed through the Host).
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - admin: address
    - config:
        type: tuple
        components:
          - transferabilityForUnitsOwner: bool
          - distributionFromAnyAddress: bool
  outputs:
    - success: bool
    - pool: address

# == Pool Member Management ==

updateMemberUnits:
  # Set a member's units in a pool. Only the pool admin can call this.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Unit changes do NOT recompute the per-unit flow rate from scratch. The pool index stores a per-unit rate set by the last distributeFlow call. If a unit increase once caused that rate to truncate to 0 (totalUnits > flowRate), decreasing units later won't recover the distribution — the per-unit rate stays 0 and the entire flow goes to the admin as the adjustment flow. More generally, the adjustment flow can only increase with unit changes (sticky) — it never decreases until distributeFlow is re-called. Fix: re-call distributeFlow with the same flow rate to force recomputation."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: admin
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - memberAddress: address
    - newUnits: uint128
    - userData: bytes
  outputs:
    - success: bool

claimAll:
  # Claim all pending distributions for a member from a pool.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - memberAddress: address
    - userData: bytes
  outputs:
    - success: bool

# == Pool Connectivity ==

connectPool:
  # Connect msg.sender to a pool for real-time distribution.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone  # connects msg.sender only
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - userData: bytes
  outputs:
    - bool

disconnectPool:
  # Disconnect msg.sender from a pool. Future distributions must be claimed.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone  # disconnects msg.sender only
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - userData: bytes
  outputs:
    - bool

# == Distribution Operations ==

distribute:
  # Instant (lump-sum) distribution from `from` into the pool.
  # Access depends on the pool's distributionFromAnyAddress config.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: admin | anyone(if-pool-allows)
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address
    - pool: address
    - requestedAmount: uint256
    - userData: bytes
  outputs:
    - bool

distributeFlow:
  # Start or update a continuous flow distribution from `from` into the pool.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: The actual flow rate may differ from the requested rate due to rounding across member units. The difference does not stay in the pool — it is streamed to the admin as a continuous adjustment flow. If requestedFlowRate < totalUnits, the per-unit rate truncates to 0 and the entire flow goes to the admin. Unit changes can only increase the adjustment flow (sticky), never decrease it. Re-call distributeFlow to reset."
    - "Gotcha: GDA has no app credit — unlike CFA, a Super App cannot borrow deposit buffer for GDA flows. The caller must fund the buffer deposit from its own balance or via ERC-20 transferFrom from the user."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: admin | anyone(if-pool-allows) | anyone(if-liquidation)
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address
    - pool: address
    - requestedFlowRate: int96
    - userData: bytes
  outputs:
    - bool

isPool:

# == Abbreviations ==
# 3Ps  — Three Periods: liquidation, patrician, and pleb (solvency model)
# ACL  — Access Control List
# ctx  — context (Superfluid call context bytes, carries msg.sender and userData)
# GDA  — General Distribution Agreement
# NFT  — Non-Fungible Token (Pool Admin NFT minted on pool creation)
# PPP  — Patrician-Pleb-Pirate (the 3Ps solvency periods)

# == Glossary ==
# pool                  — a SuperfluidPool contract that splits distributions among members by units
# pool admin            — the creator and controller of a pool; receives the adjustment flow
# pool member           — an address holding units in a pool; receives proportional distributions
# units                 — a member's share weight in a pool (uint128)
# connected member      — a member whose distributions flow in real-time to their balance
# disconnected member   — a member whose distributions accumulate and must be claimed manually
# instant distribution  — a one-shot lump-sum distribution to all pool members
# flow distribution     — a continuous per-second stream into a pool, split among members
# adjustment flow       — the difference between the requested and actual flow rate, directed to admin
# distributor           — the account sending tokens into the pool (from == ctx.msgSender)
# autoconnect slots     — limited slots (max 4) for admins to connect members on their behalf
# PoolConfig            — struct: { transferabilityForUnitsOwner: bool, distributionFromAnyAddress: bool }
# PoolERC20Metadata     — struct: { name: string, symbol: string, decimals: uint8 }
# buffer / deposit      — amount locked per flow distribution to protect against insolvency

# == Pool Creation ==

createPool:
  # Deploy a new SuperfluidPool for the given token with default ERC20 metadata.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Mints a PoolAdminNFT to the admin. The admin cannot be address(0) or a pool."
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - admin: address
    - config:
        type: tuple
        components:
          - transferabilityForUnitsOwner: bool  # if true, members can transfer units via ERC20
          - distributionFromAnyAddress: bool    # if true, anyone can distribute; else admin only
  outputs:
    - pool: address
  emits: [PoolCreated]
  errors: [GDA_NO_ZERO_ADDRESS_ADMIN, GDA_ADMIN_CANNOT_BE_POOL]

createPoolWithCustomERC20Metadata:
  # Deploy a new SuperfluidPool with custom ERC20 name, symbol, and decimals.
  # Identical to createPool but overrides the default ERC20 metadata.
  mutability: nonpayable
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - admin: address
    - config:
        type: tuple
        components:
          - transferabilityForUnitsOwner: bool
          - distributionFromAnyAddress: bool
    - poolERC20Metadata:
        type: tuple
        components:
          - name: string
          - symbol: string
          - decimals: uint8
  outputs:
    - pool: address
  emits: [PoolCreated]
  errors: [GDA_NO_ZERO_ADDRESS_ADMIN, GDA_ADMIN_CANNOT_BE_POOL]

# == Distribution Operations ==
# Distribute tokens to pool members via instant or streaming distributions.
# Functions with ctx are called through the Host's batchCall/forwardBatchCall.
# The `from` address must equal ctx.msgSender — there is no ACL support for
# distributing on behalf of others (unlike CFA operator flows).
# If the pool's distributionFromAnyAddress is false, only the pool admin can distribute.

distribute:
  # Instant (lump-sum) distribution of tokens from `from` into the pool.
  # Reverts if from != ctx.msgSender (no delegation).
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Actual amount distributed may be less than requestedAmount due to rounding. The difference stays with `from`."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: admin | anyone(if-pool-allows)
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address            # must equal ctx.msgSender
    - pool: address
    - requestedAmount: uint256
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - newCtx: bytes
  emits: [InstantDistributionUpdated]
  errors: [GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL, GDA_DISTRIBUTE_FROM_ANY_ADDRESS_NOT_ALLOWED, GDA_DISTRIBUTE_FOR_OTHERS_NOT_ALLOWED, GDA_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE]

distributeFlow:
  # Start or update a continuous flow distribution from `from` into the pool.
  # Setting requestedFlowRate to 0 closes the flow. A third party can close a flow
  # (from != ctx.msgSender) only when `from` is critical (liquidation).
  # During liquidation, reward distribution follows the same 3Ps model as CFA.
  # The pool config restriction is skipped when requestedFlowRate == 0 to allow
  # liquidators to close critical flows regardless of pool config.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Actual flow rate may differ from requested due to integer division rounding (requestedFlowRate / totalUnits). The remainder does not stay in the pool — it is streamed to the pool admin as a continuous adjustment flow."
    - "Gotcha: If requestedFlowRate < totalUnits, per-unit rate truncates to 0 and the entire flow goes to admin as adjustment."
    - "Gotcha: Unit changes (updateMemberUnits) can only increase the adjustment flow (sticky), never decrease it. Re-call distributeFlow to reset the per-unit rate and adjustment flow."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: admin | anyone(if-pool-allows) | anyone(if-liquidation)
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address            # must equal ctx.msgSender (except liquidation)
    - pool: address
    - requestedFlowRate: int96 # must be >= 0
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - newCtx: bytes
  emits: [FlowDistributionUpdated, BufferAdjusted]
  errors: [GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL, GDA_NO_NEGATIVE_FLOW_RATE, GDA_DISTRIBUTE_FROM_ANY_ADDRESS_NOT_ALLOWED, GDA_DISTRIBUTE_FOR_OTHERS_NOT_ALLOWED, GDA_NON_CRITICAL_SENDER, GDA_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE]

# == Member Management ==
# Manage pool members and claims through the Host.

updateMemberUnits:
  # Set a member's units in a pool. Only callable by the pool admin through the Host.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Delegates to the pool's updateMemberUnits, which also emits MemberUnitsUpdated and Transfer (mint/burn) from the SuperfluidPool contract."
    - "Gotcha: Unit changes do NOT recompute the per-unit flow rate. If per-unit rate was truncated to 0 (totalUnits > requestedFlowRate), changing units won't fix it. The distributor must re-call distributeFlow to reset."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: admin
  inputs:
    - untrustedPool: address
    - memberAddress: address
    - newUnits: uint128
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - newCtx: bytes
  errors: [GDA_NOT_POOL_ADMIN, SUPERFLUID_POOL_NO_POOL_MEMBERS, SUPERFLUID_POOL_NO_ZERO_ADDRESS]

claimAll:
  # Claim all pending distributions for a member from a disconnected pool membership.
  # Can be called by anyone for any member.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - untrustedPool: address
    - memberAddress: address
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - newCtx: bytes

# == Pool Connectivity ==
# Connect or disconnect accounts to pools. Connected members receive distributions
# in real-time; disconnected members must claim manually.
# connectPool/disconnectPool use ctx and are called through the Host.
# setConnectPermission is called directly (no ctx).
# Hard limit: 256 pool connections per account per token (SlotsBitmapLibrary bitmap).
# The 4 autoconnect slots (tryConnectPoolFor) are a subset of the 256.

connectPool:
  # Connect ctx.msgSender to a pool so distributions flow in real-time.
  # Anyone can call this; no check that the caller already holds units.
  # Connecting is meaningful only when the caller has (or will receive) units.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Hard limit of 256 pool connections per account per token (SlotsBitmapLibrary bitmap). Each connection also increases gas cost of balanceOf/realtimeBalanceOf, which loops over all connected pools."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone  # connects ctx.msgSender only
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - newCtx: bytes
  emits: [PoolConnectionUpdated]
  errors: [GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL]

tryConnectPoolFor:
  # Attempt to connect a member to a pool on their behalf.
  # Uses limited autoconnect slots (max 4 per member per token).
  # Returns success=false (instead of reverting) if slots are exhausted or member has opted out.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Does not work if memberAddr is a pool or address(0)."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - memberAddr: address
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - success: bool
    - newCtx: bytes
  emits: [PoolConnectionUpdated]
  errors: [GDA_CANNOT_CONNECT_POOL, GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL]

disconnectPool:
  # Disconnect ctx.msgSender from a pool. Future distributions will accumulate
  # and must be claimed manually via claimAll.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone  # disconnects ctx.msgSender only
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - ctx: bytes
  outputs:
    - newCtx: bytes
  emits: [PoolConnectionUpdated]
  errors: [GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL]

setConnectPermission:
  # Allow or deny third parties from connecting the caller to pools via tryConnectPoolFor.
  # By default, third-party connections are allowed.
  # Uses the Host's SimpleACL to grant/revoke ACL_POOL_CONNECT_EXCLUSIVE_ROLE.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Called directly — not through the Host (no ctx parameter)."
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: anyone  # sets caller's own permission
  inputs:
    - allow: bool              # true = allow (default), false = deny autoconnect

# == Distribution Queries ==

realtimeBalanceOf:
  # Compute the real-time GDA balance contribution for an account.
  # For regular accounts: returns the universal index RTB plus unsettled values
  # from all connected pools.
  # For pool accounts: returns the disconnected members' pending balance.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Returns only the GDA portion of the balance, not the total. Use SuperToken.realtimeBalanceOfNow for the full balance."
    - "Gotcha: The returned rtb is a delta, not an absolute balance. It includes unsettled connected pool distributions."
    - "Gotcha: Gas cost scales linearly with connected pools — each triggers an external call to getUnsettledValue. At high counts (approaching 256 limit), queries become expensive."
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
    - time: uint256
  outputs:
    - rtb: int256              # real-time balance delta
    - buf: uint256             # total buffer (deposit) held
    - owedBuffer: uint256      # always 0 for GDA (no owed deposit concept)

realtimeBalanceOfNow:
  # Convenience wrapper around realtimeBalanceOf using block.timestamp.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
  outputs:
    - availableBalance: int256
    - buffer: uint256
    - owedBuffer: uint256
    - timestamp: uint256

getNetFlow:
  # Net GDA flow rate for an account. Includes incoming flows from connected pools
  # and, for pool accounts, the disconnected members' flow rate.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
  outputs:
    - netFlowRate: int96

getFlowRate:
  # Flow rate from a distributor to a specific pool.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address
    - to: address              # the pool
  outputs:
    - int96

getFlow:
  # Full flow data from a distributor to a pool.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address
    - to: address              # the pool
  outputs:
    - lastUpdated: uint256
    - flowRate: int96
    - deposit: uint256

getAccountFlowInfo:
  # Aggregated GDA flow state for an account across all its distribution flows.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
  outputs:
    - timestamp: uint256       # last update time
    - flowRate: int96          # net flow rate
    - deposit: uint256         # total buffer across all flows

# == Estimation ==
# Optimistic estimates of actual distribution amounts and flow rates.
# NOTE: These are only precise within an atomic transaction.
# DO NOT rely on these if querying off-chain.

estimateFlowDistributionActualFlowRate:
  # Estimate the actual flow rate for a given request based on current pool state.
  # actualFlowRate = floor(requestedFlowRate / totalUnits) * totalUnits.
  # The initial adjustment flow is requestedFlowRate - actualFlowRate (small rounding remainder).
  # NOTE: After unit changes, the actual adjustment flow may be higher due to sticky behavior.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Only precise in an atomic transaction — do not rely on off-chain queries."
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address
    - to: address              # the pool
    - requestedFlowRate: int96
  outputs:
    - actualFlowRate: int96
    - totalDistributionFlowRate: int96

estimateDistributionActualAmount:
  # Estimate the actual distributed amount for a given requested amount.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Only precise in an atomic transaction — do not rely on off-chain queries."
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - from: address
    - to: address              # the pool
    - requestedAmount: uint256
  outputs:
    - actualAmount: uint256

# == Pool Info Queries ==

isPool:
  # Check whether an address is a registered SuperfluidPool for the given token.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
  outputs:
    - bool

isMemberConnected:
  # Check whether a member is connected to a pool.
  notes:
    - "Gotcha: Returns false for invalid pools (never reverts)."
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - pool: address
    - member: address
  outputs:
    - bool

getPoolAdjustmentFlowRate:
  # Get the adjustment flow rate for a pool (the flow going to the pool admin).
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - pool: address
  outputs:
    - int96

getPoolAdjustmentFlowInfo:
  # Get full adjustment flow info: recipient (always admin), flow hash, and flow rate.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - pool: address
  outputs:
    - recipient: address
    - flowHash: bytes32
    - flowRate: int96

# == Solvency Queries ==

isPatricianPeriodNow:
  # Check patrician period status using the Host's current timestamp.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
  outputs:
    - isCurrentlyPatricianPeriod: bool
    - timestamp: uint256

isPatricianPeriod:
  # Check patrician period status at a specific timestamp.
  mutability: view
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - account: address
    - timestamp: uint256
  outputs:
    - bool

# == Pool-Only Operations ==
# Can only be called by legitimate pool contracts (msg.sender must be a pool
# registered with the token via isPool). These are internal protocol plumbing.

appendIndexUpdateByPool:
  # Called by a pool after a member unit update to propagate the index change
  # and adjust the pool's adjustment flow rate.
  # NOTE: Recomputes the adjustment flow using the existing per-unit rate in the pool
  # index — does NOT recompute the per-unit rate itself from the distributor's requested
  # flow rate. This is why unit changes can't recover a distribution that was truncated to 0.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: pool
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - p:
        type: tuple
        components:
          - _settled_at: uint32
          - _flow_rate: int128
          - _settled_value: int256
    - t: uint32
  outputs:
    - bool
  errors: [GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL]

poolSettleClaim:
  # Called by a pool to settle a claim for a member, shifting value from pool to recipient.
  mutability: nonpayable
  access: pool
  inputs:
    - token: address
    - claimRecipient: address
    - amount: int256
  outputs:
    - bool
  errors: [GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL]

# == Protocol Constants ==

agreementType:
  # Returns keccak256("org.superfluid-finance.agreements.GeneralDistributionAgreement.v1")
  mutability: pure
  outputs:
    - bytes32

superfluidPoolBeacon:
  # Address of the UpgradeableBeacon for SuperfluidPool implementation.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

MAX_POOL_AUTO_CONNECT_SLOTS:
  # Maximum autoconnect slots per member per token: 4.
  # This is a subset of the 256-slot bitmap (see SLOTS_BITMAP_LIBRARY_ADDRESS).
  # Self-connections via connectPool are not limited by this — only by the
  # 256 bitmap ceiling.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - uint32

ACL_POOL_CONNECT_EXCLUSIVE_ROLE:
  # keccak256("ACL_POOL_CONNECT_EXCLUSIVE_ROLE") — role used to opt out of autoconnect.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - bytes32

SLOTS_BITMAP_LIBRARY_ADDRESS:
  # Address of the SlotsBitmapLibrary used for pool connection tracking.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

SUPERFLUID_POOL_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:
  # Address of the SuperfluidPoolDeployerLibrary.
  mutability: view
  outputs:
    - address

# == Events ==

events:
  PoolCreated:
    # Emitted when a new pool is created via createPool or createPoolWithCustomERC20Metadata.
    indexed:
      - token: address
      - admin: address
    data:
      - pool: address

  InstantDistributionUpdated:
    # Emitted on instant (lump-sum) distributions.
    indexed:
      - token: address
      - pool: address
      - distributor: address
    data:
      - operator: address        # ctx.msgSender
      - requestedAmount: uint256
      - actualAmount: uint256    # may be less than requested due to rounding
      - userData: bytes

  FlowDistributionUpdated:
    # Emitted on create, update, or delete of a flow distribution.
    indexed:
      - token: address
      - pool: address
      - distributor: address
    data:
      - operator: address        # ctx.msgSender
      - oldFlowRate: int96
      - newDistributorToPoolFlowRate: int96
      - newTotalDistributionFlowRate: int96
      - adjustmentFlowRecipient: address
      - adjustmentFlowRate: int96
      - userData: bytes

  PoolConnectionUpdated:
    # Emitted when a member connects to or disconnects from a pool.
    indexed:
      - token: address
      - pool: address
      - account: address
    data:
      - connected: bool
      - userData: bytes

  BufferAdjusted:
    # Emitted when a flow distribution's buffer (deposit) changes.
    indexed:
      - token: address
      - pool: address
      - from: address
    data:
      - bufferDelta: int256
      - newBufferAmount: uint256
      - totalBufferAmount: uint256

  # Inherited events (from AgreementBase / UUPSProxiable):
  # CodeUpdated — emitted on proxy upgrade (uuid, codeAddress)
  # Initialized — emitted on proxy initialization (version)

# == Errors ==

errors:
  # Pool creation
  - GDA_ADMIN_CANNOT_BE_POOL       # admin address is itself a pool
  - GDA_NO_ZERO_ADDRESS_ADMIN      # admin is address(0)
  # Distribution
  - GDA_DISTRIBUTE_FOR_OTHERS_NOT_ALLOWED   # from != ctx.msgSender (no ACL)
  - GDA_DISTRIBUTE_FROM_ANY_ADDRESS_NOT_ALLOWED  # pool restricts to admin only
  - GDA_NO_NEGATIVE_FLOW_RATE      # requestedFlowRate < 0
  # Solvency
  - GDA_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE       # distributor cannot cover deposit or distribution
  - GDA_NON_CRITICAL_SENDER        # third-party close but sender is solvent
  - GDA_FLOW_DOES_NOT_EXIST
  # Pool membership / ACL
  - GDA_NOT_POOL_ADMIN             # caller is not the pool admin
  - GDA_ONLY_SUPER_TOKEN_POOL      # address is not a registered pool
  - GDA_CANNOT_CONNECT_POOL        # memberAddr is address(0) or a pool
  # Super App / Host
  - AGREEMENT_BASE_ONLY_HOST       # call not routed through the Host contract
  # SafeCast (inherited from OpenZeppelin)
  - SafeCastOverflowedIntDowncast:
      inputs:
        - bits: uint8
        - value: int256
  - SafeCastOverflowedIntToUint:
      inputs:
        - value: int256
  - SafeCastOverflowedUintDowncast:
      inputs:
        - bits: uint8
        - value: uint256
  - SafeCastOverflowedUintToInt:
      inputs:
        - value: uint256
